name: MACOM Technology Solutions
outlook:
What MACOM Technology Solutions says to expect

  • First quarter fiscal 2027: revenue, gross margin and EPSFor the fiscal first quarter ending January 1, 2027, MACOM expects revenue to be in the range of $450 million to $460 million. Adjusted gross margin is expected to be between 62.0% and 63.0%, and adjusted earnings per diluted share is expected to be between $2.21 and $2.29 utilizing an anticipated non-GAAP income tax rate of 6% and 79.0 million fully diluted shares outstanding.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
